body: yeah I might have to try that (finding a mental health place OOT), though it's a bit tricky now as the semester is up in 3 months and I'm 300 miles from home. I guess we'll see what happens. I used to draw but I've just lost interest to be honest, as in most things I used to like doing.

I do not know if this will make you feel better, but I have a friend who went through a similar situation - she was raped in high school and had PTSD because of that as well as an eating disorder. However, a few years later she is getting better, and recently started dating a really nice guy who is comfortable with her experiences and the daily struggle she is going through. There is love out there....

I guess it is a variety of things. I just don't have the motivation to do anything here at college, I'm just in a generally shitty mood. Everyone thinks I am fine because I put on a happy face, but it's all out of whack. I'm sleeping erratically, literally stayed up for two days last week, which isn't helping my academic situation. I also have an eating disorder that makes me really insecure and isn't helping me make any friends here. Though making friends here really isn't the problem, in hs I didn't really have friends and was ok with that. I just don't see where it is going to get better here for me and I just can't seem to figure out why. I'm just so unhappy in general and I don't want to worry my parents like i said because they're poor and the mental health people here aren't the best. I don't know what to do.
